item.title: Arctic air causing sub-zero wind chills
item.description: Bitter cold temperatures are expected to hit the Ozarks this Sunday, with wind chill values dipping below zero, but the cold won't last long as temperatures are expected to rebound by as much as 20 degrees by Monday and reach the 60s by Wednesday.

item.title: Former news anchor and Silver Dollar City PR Director dies at age 64
item.description: Lisa Rau, former Ozarks news anchor and Silver Dollar City Director of Public Relations, passed away at the age of 64, leaving behind a legacy of dedication to the Ozarks community and the City of Branson.
